title: Print Hello Kitty's Face
summary: Print the provided ASCII art exactly as shown.

statement.text: Print the Hello Kitty face exactly as shown in the sample output. Every space and punctuation mark matters.

output: Print the ASCII art exactly as shown.
constraints: Do not add extra blank lines.
hints: Use System.out.println() for each line.
Keep the spacing exactly as shown.

title: Hello Kitty's Name
summary: Store a name in a variable and print it.

statement.text: Create a String variable with the value **Hello Kitty** and print it on one line.

output: Print `Hello Kitty` exactly.
hints: Use a String variable.
Use System.out.println().

title: Kitty's Age in Cat Years
summary: Convert a human age into cat years.

statement.text: Read an integer age and convert it to cat years by multiplying by 7.

output: One integer representing age * 7.
hints: Use Scanner to read the number.
Multiply by 7.

title: Kitty's Favorite Food
summary: Echo the favorite food in a friendly sentence.

statement.text: Read a full line describing Hello Kitty's favorite food and print the sentence shown in the output section.

input: One line of text (may include spaces).
output: Print `Hello Kitty loves X!` where X is the line you read.
constraints: Preserve the original capitalization of the food.
hints: Use Scanner.nextLine().

title: Kitty's Bow Color
summary: Print the bow color in uppercase.

statement.text: Read one line containing the bow color and print it in uppercase.

output: The same text in uppercase.
hints: Use toUpperCase().

title: Kitty's Friendship Check
summary: Check if the name is Mimi (case-insensitive).

statement.text: Read a name and check if it matches **Mimi** (case-insensitive). Print the correct message based on the result.

output: Print `Best friends forever!` if the name is Mimi.
Otherwise print `Let's be friends!`.
constraints: Name length is at least 1 character.
hints: Use equalsIgnoreCase().

title: Kitty's Age Comparison
summary: Compare an age to Hello Kitty's age of 48.

statement.text: Read an integer age and compare it to Hello Kitty's age (48). Print the correct message.

output: Print `You're older than Hello Kitty!` if age > 48.
Otherwise print `You're younger than Hello Kitty!`.
hints: Use an if-else statement.

title: Hello Kitty Fact Lookup
summary: Choose a fact by number and print it.

statement.text: Read an integer from 1 to 4 and print the corresponding fact.

items: 2 - She has a twin sister named Mimi.
3 - Hello Kitty's real name is Kitty White.
4 - She is not a cat, but a little girl!

output: The fact that matches the number.
constraints: The input is always between 1 and 4.

examples.output: She has a twin sister named Mimi.

hints: Use a switch statement or if-else chain.

testCases.output: She is not a cat, but a little girl!

title: Kitty's Jump Height
summary: Compute the jump height from weight and energy.

statement.text: Given Kitty's weight and energy, compute the jump height using the formula `sqrt(energy) / weight`. Print the result rounded to two decimals.

output: One number formatted to exactly two decimal places.
hints: Use Math.sqrt and printf with %.2f.

title: Kitty's Lucky Number
summary: Check if the number matches 7.

statement.text: Read an integer and check if it is Hello Kitty's lucky number (7).

output: Print `You guessed Hello Kitty's lucky number!` if the number is 7.
Otherwise print `Try again!`.

examples.output: You guessed Hello Kitty's lucky number!

hints: Use an if-else statement.

testCases.output: You guessed Hello Kitty's lucky number!

title: Name Formatter
summary: Reformat a first and last name.

statement.text: Read a first name and a last name, then print them in the format `Last, First`.

input: Two words: first name then last name.
output: The last name, a comma, a space, and the first name.
constraints: Each name is at least 1 character.
hints: Use Scanner.next() to read each word.

title: Vowel Count
summary: Count the vowels in a line of text.

statement.text: Read a line of text and count how many vowels it contains. Vowels are a, e, i, o, and u (case-insensitive).

output: A single integer representing the vowel count.
constraints: The line length is at most 200 characters.
hints: Convert the string to lowercase.
Check each character.

title: Array Sum
summary: Compute the sum of a list of integers.

statement.text: Read an integer n followed by n integers. Print their sum.

input: An integer n followed by n integers.
output: The sum of the n integers.
constraints: Each integer fits in a 32-bit signed range.
hints: Use a loop to accumulate the sum.

title: Even and Odd Count
summary: Count the number of even and odd values.

statement.text: Read n integers and count how many are even and how many are odd.

input: An integer n followed by n integers.
output: Print `Evens: X` on the first line.
Print `Odds: Y` on the second line.
constraints: Each integer fits in a 32-bit signed range.
hints: Use value % 2 to detect even numbers.

title: Diagonal Sum
summary: Sum the main diagonal of a square matrix.

statement.text: Read an integer n followed by an n x n matrix. Print the sum of the main diagonal (where row index equals column index).

input: An integer n followed by n x n integers.
output: The diagonal sum.
constraints: Matrix values fit in a 32-bit signed range.
hints: Only add values where i == j.

title: Row with Maximum Sum
summary: Find the row index with the largest sum.

statement.text: Read a matrix with r rows and c columns. Compute the sum of each row and print the index (0-based) of the row with the largest sum. If there is a tie, print the smallest index.

input: Two integers r and c followed by r x c integers.
output: The 0-based index of the row with the largest sum.
constraints: Matrix values fit in a 32-bit signed range.
hints: Track the best sum and index as you scan rows.

title: First Unique Character
summary: Find the index of the first non-repeating character.

statement.text: Read a string and return the index (0-based) of the first character that appears exactly once. If none exist, print -1.

input: One line containing a string (no spaces).
output: The index of the first unique character, or -1.
hints: Count character frequencies first, then scan again.

title: Max Sum of Length K
summary: Find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of length k.

statement.text: Read n, k, and then n integers. Find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of length k.

input: An integer n, an integer k, then n integers.
output: The maximum subarray sum of length k.
constraints: Array values fit in a 32-bit signed range.
hints: Use a sliding window to keep the sum in O(n).

title: Sum of Digits (Recursive)
summary: Use recursion to sum the digits of a number.

statement.text: Read a non-negative integer and compute the sum of its digits using recursion.

output: The sum of its digits.
hints: Use n % 10 and n / 10 in a recursive function.

title: Palindrome Check
summary: Determine if a phrase is a palindrome.

statement.text: Read a line of text. Ignore spaces and case, then decide if the string is a palindrome. Print YES or NO.

output: Print `YES` if it is a palindrome, otherwise print `NO`.
constraints: Line length is at most 200 characters.
hints: Remove spaces and compare from both ends.

title: Student Average
summary: Use a class to compute a student's average score.

statement.text: Create a Student class with a name and three scores. Compute the average score and print it with one decimal place.

input: A name followed by three integer scores.
output: Print `Name: average` with one decimal place.
hints: Average = (s1 + s2 + s3) / 3.0

title: Robot Moves
summary: Simulate moves on a grid.

statement.text: A robot starts at (0, 0). Read a string of commands (N, E, S, W) and compute the final position.

input: One line containing the command string.
output: Two integers: final x and y coordinates separated by a space.
constraints: Commands contain only N, E, S, W.
hints: Use a loop and update x/y for each character.
